# grafana_assistant_automation (Resource)

Manages a Grafana Assistant Automation: a saved Assistant prompt that runs on
demand or on a cron schedule. Each run creates its own Assistant conversation.

Automations are a Grafana Cloud-only feature and require the Grafana Assistant app.

Scheduled runs use the creator's Grafana permissions, so the credentials Terraform uses must have
access to everything the prompt needs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grafana_assistant_automation" "daily_incident_report" {
  name        = "Daily ecommerce incident report"
  description = "Every morning, summarize the alerts that fired for the ecommerce app."

  prompt = <<-EOT
    Produce a daily report on the incidents for the main alerts that fired in
    the last 24 hours for the ecommerce app in the ecommerce-prod namespace.

    For each alert: how long it fired, which services were affected, and
    whether it correlates with a deploy. Close with the single most important
    thing to look at today.
  EOT

  # Shared with everybody in the org, rather than private to the creator.
  scope   = "tenant"
  enabled = true

  # Standard 5-field cron. Schedules must be at least 15 minutes apart.
  schedule_cron     = "0 9 * * *"
  schedule_timezone = "Europe/Paris"

  notifications {
    slack {
      enabled   = true
      notify_on = ["completed", "failed"]

      target {
        type       = "channel"
        channel_id = "C0123456789"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-friendly automation name.
- `prompt` (String) The prompt sent to Assistant on each run. Prefix with `/<skill-name>` to start from a skill.

### Optional

- `context_items` (String) Context items attached to the prompt, as a JSON array string.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the automation runs on its schedule. Disabled automations can still be run manually.
- `notifications` (Block, Optional) Where to send the result of each run. Webhook notifications are not supported by this resource because their URL and credentials are write-only secure settings the API never returns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications))
- `schedule_cron` (String) Standard 5-field cron expression, for example `0 9 * * 1-5`. Omit for a manual-only automation. Schedules must be at least 15 minutes apart.
- `schedule_timezone` (String) IANA timezone the schedule is interpreted in, for example `Europe/Paris`.
- `scope` (String) Visibility. `user` keeps the automation private to its creator; `tenant` shares it with everybody in the org.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the resource.
- `next_run_at` (String) When the automation is next scheduled to fire.

<a id="nestedblock--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Optional:

- `email` (Block, Optional) Email delivery. Email notifications must be enabled for the stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications--email))
- `slack` (Block, Optional) Slack delivery. Requires the Slack workspace to already be connected to the stack, which is a one-time manual step in Assistant settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications--slack))

<a id="nestedblock--notifications--email"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications.email`

Optional:

- `addresses` (List of String) Recipient email addresses, up to 25.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent.
- `notify_on` (List of String) Run outcomes that trigger a notification. Any of `completed`, `failed`, `needs_approval`.


<a id="nestedblock--notifications--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications.slack`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Slack notifications are sent.
- `notify_on` (List of String) Run outcomes that trigger a notification. Any of `completed`, `failed`, `needs_approval`.
- `target` (Block, Optional) Where the notification is posted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications--slack--target))

<a id="nestedblock--notifications--slack--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications.slack.target`

Optional:

- `channel_id` (String) Slack channel ID. Required for a `channel` target.
- `team_id` (String) Slack workspace (team) ID.
- `type` (String) Target type. One of `channel` or `dm`. Required when a `target` block is present.
- `user_id` (String) Slack user ID. Required for a `dm` target.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import grafana_assistant_automation.name "{{ id }}"
```
